args.text: CREATE TABLE S (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_S PRIMARY KEY, T TEXT(30), M MEMO, D DOUBLE, DT DATETIME)
INSERT INTO S VALUES (1, '  AbCd  ', 'memo text here', 1234.56, #2024-03-05 14:07:09#)
INSERT INTO S VALUES (2, Null, Null, Null, Null)

SELECT String$(3, 'a') AS c_str3, String$(300, 'a') AS c_str300, Space$(3) AS c_spc3, LTrim$(T) AS c_lt, RTrim$(T) AS c_rt, Right$(T, 2) AS c_r, Mid$(T, 2, 3) AS c_m, Left$(T, 3) AS c_l, Chr$(65) AS c_chr, Format$(D, '0.00') AS c_fmtd INTO OutDollar FROM S WHERE ID = 1

SELECT Format(D, '#,##0.00') AS c_fmt, FormatNumber(D, 2) AS c_fnum, DateAdd('d', 1, DT) AS c_da, DateDiff('d', #2024-01-01#, DT) AS c_dd, DatePart('yyyy', DT) AS c_dp, Weekday(DT) AS c_wd, WeekdayName(1) AS c_wdn, Year(DT) AS c_yr, StrConv(T, 3) AS c_sc INTO OutPartC FROM S WHERE ID = 1

SELECT Format(D, '0.00') AS c_fmt, FormatNumber(D, 2) AS c_fnum, DateAdd('d', 1, DT) AS c_da, DateDiff('d', #2024-01-01#, DT) AS c_dd, DatePart('yyyy', DT) AS c_dp, Weekday(DT) AS c_wd, Year(DT) AS c_yr, StrConv(T, 3) AS c_sc INTO OutNull FROM S WHERE ID = 2
SELECT Left$(T, 2) AS c_l INTO OutNullDollar FROM S WHERE ID = 2
